corrected_prior_errors: ToolsView defaults to Agent surface and filters by CANONICAL_SURFACE. All handlers exposes the three internal delegates; the two canonical names remain on Agent surface. The corrected UI steps follow this source behavior.

wxt.config.ts declares sessions in required Chrome permissions and excludes it from optional_permissions. The corrected cases require a loaded-artifact/install preflight and no optional Settings grant. Handler required_optional_permissions metadata does not change the manifest declaration.
coverage_limits: These five cases exercise direct Tools manual Run, which bypasses dispatcher authorization; they cannot clear the inventory's gated/negative permission, live agent binding, or Ask/Act gaps.
The common setup inherits PLAN.md resource permit and receipt requirements, but execution still requires an actual admitted browser run and exact loaded build identity. No such run was observed.

The procedures identify synthetic/public data ownership and restrict evidence, but should specify disposal of created tabs, download files, and profile history after evidence capture before long-lived reuse.

integration_verdict: Integrate the corrected positive manual procedures as unverified design text only, preserving existing status/result cells and unresolved gated/negative coverage. Keep EXT-F-4043-T01 conditional on an owned completed-download fixture. Add explicit fixture cleanup and separate negative/permission cases before claiming complete feature coverage.
